analisis_condicion_iva.description: terse note: what IVA condition legend the emitter declares (if any), and whether the document discriminates IVA at all (does it show a rate + amount, or just a bottom-line total?). This decides the Factura C branch below: when the emitter is Monotributo or Exento, iva and the other taxes are '0' and subtotal is the total

subtotal.description: net amount, or the total if not discriminated

iva.description: the IVA amount in pesos, never the rate: a receipt showing 'IVA 21%: 2.100,00' has iva '2.100,00', and 21 goes in alicuotas_detectadas. '0' when the document does not discriminate IVA

monto_no_gravado.description: printed amount, or "0". Not the same as 'exento': a non-taxed amount is outside the IVA base, an exempt one is inside it and taxed at 0%

importe_total_facturado.description: total as printed, with no adjustments

condicion_impositiva_dominante.description: the emitter's IVA condition, or 'null' when it is not declared. Same conclusion as analisis_condicion_iva above, in the fixed legend form

alicuotas_detectadas.description: the printed IVA rates, with the AFIP codes: 0, 2_5, 5, 10_5, 21, 27, separated by '|'. The rates, never the amounts
